name: vision
description: Vision sanity + token-budget probe. Run at different --image-max-tokens to compare what Chotu perceives vs token/latency cost.

ticks.input: What do you see right now? Describe the objects on the surface in front of you.
ticks.note: Coarse scene understanding — should work even at low token budget (70-140)

ticks.input: Is there anything blocking your path forward, or is it clear to move?
ticks.note: Navigation-grade perception — the actual Chotu use case

ticks.input: Read any text you can see.
ticks.note: OCR-grade — should DEGRADE at low budget, need 560+ to read the whiteboard
